scope.interpretation: Single-seed clean checkpoint only. No attack outcome or quantization/context effect can be estimated from this cohort.

analysis_provenance.score_source: pinned AgentDojo programmatic task utility and injection state checkers; no LLM judge
analysis_provenance.latency_source: result.duration_seconds (monotonic wall-clock), includes errors, tools and client overhead
analysis_provenance.token_source: native response usage, summed across actual requests; repeated prompt context counts again
analysis_provenance.throughput_source: native decode sums max(predicted_n-1,0) / sum(predicted_ms/1000), matching the pinned llama.cpp first-token-in-prefill convention; prefill sums prompt_n / sum(prompt_ms/1000); response throughput separately uses usage.completion_tokens / client response latency
analysis_provenance.exposure_source: result.observed_injection_vectors; exact payload normalized/raw-or-YAML matcher before each sent request
analysis_provenance.memory_source: server_memory.peak_rss_bytes sampled every 0.1s; unified/GPU total and harness memory unmeasured
analysis_provenance.startup_source: captured runtime metadata ready_at minus started_at, deduplicated by pid/start timestamp; OS caches uncontrolled
analysis_provenance.intervals: 95% Wilson if one episode per unique task; otherwise deterministic task-cluster bootstrap stratified by suite, 2000 percentile resamples seed0; one cluster has no bootstrap interval; all-equal clusters can produce degenerate intervals
analysis_provenance.annotation_source: manual trace review only; refusal candidates are regex triage, never automatically scored

runtime_protocol.weight_format: F16, normalization weights F32; no quantized tensors
runtime_protocol.hardware: Apple M2 Max, 64 GiB unified memory
runtime_protocol.memory_scope: Sampled inference-server process RSS only; total GPU/unified memory, harness and whole-host memory are unmeasured.

limitations: One observation per fixed task; Wilson intervals are descriptive and do not establish random-sample generalization. Two-seed final analysis must retain task clusters.
Two timeout scores remain unknown, not capability failures or security evidence. Available tokens omit failed-request computation.
Agent qualitative trace review is not independent human annotation or a validated LLM judge. Official programmatic scores are retained despite documented checker limitations.
Clean-first fixed suite order, changing task mix and concurrent offline review/audits/tests/plot setup confound latency and RSS comparisons with host load and thermal drift.
No attacks in this cohort and no controlled alternate precision/context condition; no ASR or treatment effect is available.
completion_requirements: Finish all 120 clean and 480 attack episodes, review all 120 clean plus the final deterministic 30-trace sample and 30 supplemental attack cases, then complete the full collection/provenance audit and paired assessment.
